node.title: Every official nonidentity shifted-product fiber is below 33 n^(2/3)
node.statement: For every prime-field C36 row n=2^s, 13<=s<=41, p=1 mod n, p>=n^2, and every tau in F_p^*\{1}, the shifted-product fiber P(tau)=#{(a,b) in ((1-H)\{0})^2:ab=tau} satisfies P(tau)<33n^(2/3). The proof applies the constants-explicit Konyagin--Shparlinski--Vyugin auxiliary construction after the subgroup-preserving bijection (x,y)->(U,V)=(x,x/y), which gives the irreducible bidegree-(2,1) curve U^2-UV-U+(1-tau)V with a two-term lowest homogeneous part. All finite parameter inequalities and floor repairs are proved on the 29 official orders. This is a marginal bound only and does not prove the weighted C36' correlation.
